scope: Order creation cascade POS -> KDS (7 hops): PosController -> OrderService -> OrderCreated event -> 4 listeners -> DomainEvent outbox row -> DispatchDomainEventsJob -> KdsSyncController/KdsSyncService -> admin-kds.js render

cascade_integrity.evidence: app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php:145-151 — OrderCreated subscribers in this order: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox (line 147 — SSOT-first per F-002 round-3 comment), DecrementItemAvailabilityOnOrder (148), DecrementStockOnOrderCreated (149), SendFcmOnOrderCreated (150). The SSOT defense is honored: even if FCM (last) throws, outbox already wrote.
cascade_integrity.after_commit_guard: app/Events/OrderCreated.php:14 + app/Events/Concerns/DispatchableAfterCommit.php:30-42 — event() dispatch deferred via DB::afterCommit(); on rollback the closure is silently dropped. Consumers never observe orders that did not persist.
cascade_integrity.idempotency_outbox_write: app/Listeners/PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox.php:22 — sha1(event_type|aggregate_id) keyed firstOrCreate. Listener replay (queue retry between persistence and post-commit dispatch) absorbed by UNIQUE index + wasRecentlyCreated short-circuit (line 57). Sibling parity comment refs PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox:92 and PersistCouponChangedToOutbox:82.
cascade_integrity.idempotency_broadcast_job: app/Jobs/DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:65-86 — Phase 1 atomic claim under lockForUpdate + dispatched_at guard. Losing worker observes dispatched_at != null after lock, returns silently (Log::info line 89). Phase 2 broadcast happens AFTER claim transaction commits to honour the commit_before_dispatch invariant. Test sentinel: tests/Feature/Outbox/OutboxConcurrentWorkerDedupeTest.php:46-90 — second handle() call no-ops.

findings.title: Stale rollback comment in DecrementStockOnOrderCreated — re-throw no longer rolls back order
findings.evidence_read: DecrementStockOnOrderCreated:17-20 says 'Domain-expected exception — let it bubble up to the request stack so the order creation transaction can be rolled back upstream. (Pre-iter12 behavior preserved.)' AND :22-37 logs+rethrows on Throwable saying 'The order transaction (which spawned this event after-commit) stays consistent — a hard fail surfaces the orphan'.
findings.actual_behavior: OrderCreated uses DispatchableAfterCommit (app/Events/OrderCreated.php:14) — event() runs in DB::afterCommit() closure (DispatchableAfterCommit:35-39). When a listener throws there, the transaction has ALREADY committed. Re-throwing only (a) propagates a 500 to whatever code triggered the event() (likely the request stack since after-commit fires at end of outer transaction wrapper), and (b) prevents sibling listener SendFcmOnOrderCreated (line 150) from firing. Outbox already wrote (line 147 = first listener). Stock decrement DID happen via StockService::decrementForOrder.
findings.impact: Mid-severity: the order exists with paid status, outbox event broadcasts to KDS, but the HTTP response surfaces a 500 to POS / kiosk client. UX-confusing (operator sees 'failed' for an order that physically exists and is already on the KDS). Pre-iter12 mental model in the comment is no longer accurate.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) update comment to reflect after-commit reality + add explicit Sentry breadcrumb + return without re-throw (event() in afterCommit closure should NOT bubble up HTTP error for already-committed state), or (b) keep re-throw but document that the consumer sees a 500 and must reconcile via OSS. Decide with PK-4 RESILIENCE — listener failure isolation policy needs to be unified across the four OrderCreated listeners (SendFcm already isolated per :109-120, AvailabilityService throws on missing relation, Stock throws on Throwable).
findings.scope_minimal_fix: 1-line comment fix + optional 3-line try/catch wrap (clean file, not frozen, not DIRTY). Defer to PK-4 unifier.

findings.title: BroadcastableOrder interface is intentionally empty — listener depends on structural typing of concrete models
findings.evidence_read: BroadcastableOrder:11-16 is an empty marker interface. PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox:30-42 reads off `$order->branch_id`, `queue_number`, `payment_status`, `payment_method`, `pos_payment_method`, `source_surface`, `payment_status`, `status`, `order_type`, `total`, `created_at` — none guaranteed by the contract; only convention (per the file's docblock 'Both models expose: id, branch_id, queue_number, status, order_type, total, token, created_at').
findings.impact: Brittle but currently working: Order and FrontendOrder both expose all read fields. Risk: any future model implementing BroadcastableOrder (e.g. a hypothetical OnlineOrder, BulkOrder, DemoOrder) would crash with 'Undefined property' inside the outbox listener — a hidden production booby-trap.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X: tighten the interface with documented getter contract (getBranchId, getQueueNumber, getPaymentMethod, getOrderTotal, getOriginSurface) so PHP type-check catches drift at compile-time. Out-of-scope for this audit cycle — no acute breach.
findings.scope_minimal_fix: DEFERRED V1.0.X — backlog item only, no acute breach.

findings.title: Best-effort broadcast catch silently swallows ALL exceptions during after-commit dispatch
findings.evidence_read: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox:67-78 wraps DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch in try/Throwable and logs warning (E-001 round-3 cluster-8). Comment: 'broadcast best-effort; do not fail HTTP on Pusher dispatch error'.
findings.impact: DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch in Laravel 9+ writes to the queue (Redis / database). If the queue connection is down, the job never lands → KDS never gets the push (polling fallback still works since the order row exists). The Log::warning at :70 is the ONLY surface. No alert / metric increment.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.X: emit a counter increment to SyncMetricsRecorder so a monitoring dashboard can alarm on 'outbox_inline_dispatch_failures > N/min'. Currently the failure is invisible until the polling fallback masks the gap. Out-of-scope to fix here — observability hardening backlog.

findings.title: DispatchKdsTicket lingers as a parallel push channel separate from outbox
findings.evidence_read: KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService::changeStatus:241-245 directly invokes DispatchKdsTicket->dispatch in a try/catch outside the outbox. This is for the status-change flow (not order creation) but worth flagging because it represents a second sync path that bypasses the V1 envelope contract.
findings.impact: Status changes bypass EventContract::assertEnvelopeValid (DispatchDomainEventsJob:110). PK-2 STATUS-SYNC zone.
findings.recommendation: Hand off to PK-2 — out of scope here.

keeps: Listener registration order (Outbox-first, FCM-last) — F-002 round-3 invariant preserved. Defense-in-depth proven by the fact that even with PK1-ARCH-01 stale comment, Outbox writes BEFORE Stock can throw.
Outbox idempotency via sha1(event_type|aggregate_id) + UNIQUE index + wasRecentlyCreated guard — Sprint 3B P1-SYNC-03 parity with PersistCatalogChanged + PersistCouponChanged listeners.
lockForUpdate claim pattern in DispatchDomainEventsJob (NEW-01) — concurrent workers cannot double-broadcast. Test sentinel: tests/Feature/Outbox/OutboxConcurrentWorkerDedupeTest.php.
DispatchableAfterCommit trait — fires after outer transaction commit, drops on rollback. KI-001 / gate C9 invariant preserved.
Backoff curve [1, 5, 15, 60, 300] tries=6 — total ~6.4 min retry window > typical Pusher/Soketi restart. NEW-03 / Audit T G2.

EventContract V1 envelope validation BEFORE broadcast (DispatchDomainEventsJob:110) — REQUIRED_PAYLOAD_KEYS for ORDER_CREATED = ['order_id', 'queue_number', '_origin', 'payment_method']. PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox:31-42 satisfies this (and more).
Correlation ID propagation (PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox:82-98 + HasCorrelationId trait on DispatchDomainEventsJob:22) — observable end-to-end.
